16/S0.subgoal: Explain why tracking is essential in XR systems and how its requirements differ between VR and AR.

16/S1.subgoal: Describe the three categories of tracking based on what is being tracked: sense organs, other body parts, and the surrounding environment.

16/S2.subgoal: Describe the factors that determine how tracking is done and explain inside-out versus outside-in tracking based on tracker position.

16/S3.subgoal: Describe the four broad steps of the tracking process: calibration, registration, integration, and drift correction.

16/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the topics to be covered next.
